_notes.title: Optional. The small line above the planet's name on the title card. Default: Tiny Planet.
_notes.planetName: Required. The planet's name, shown on the title card and the result card.
_notes.playerName: Required. The explorer's name, shown on the result card.
_notes.theme: Required. One of meadow (green land, blue seas), tundra (snow, ice, and pines), or ember (dark rock, glowing lava seas).
_notes.seed: Required. Any word. The same word always grows the same planet, with the crystals in the same places.
_notes.daySeconds: Optional. How long the day lasts, in seconds, from 30 to 1800. Default: 120.
_notes.crystals: Optional. How many crystals are hidden, from 1 to 24. Default: 7.
